prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original Noxian Drake-Hound unupgraded creature master for an additional Heroes of Might and Magic III town, on genuine transparent alpha.
Input roles: image1 official dragon-dog concept and image2 nobles' hounds are ANATOMY/SUBJECT references only, not tracing or artist-style imitation. Image3 Noxus icon is heraldry shape reference. Image4 project Legion soldier is painted-material/rendering reference only, no humanoid parts.
The creature must read unmistakably as a dragon DOG: lean muscular hairless sighthound / Doberman-like canine build, deep forward chest, very tucked waist, long strong legs planted UNDER its body, raised hocks, compact clawed dog paws, proud curved neck, alert sharply tapered ear-like horn lobes swept back, angular dog-length muzzle and visible lower jaw. Dark charcoal and muted plum leathery scaled hide with a few broad bony ridges along neck and back, NOT dense crocodile scutes. Long slim tapering expressive tail, two or three restrained blade-shaped tail fins. Single head, four legs, no wings. Lean agile wolf-sized warbeast rather than chunky baby dragon. Head/jaw must remain readable at 48-pixel body height.
Basic worn dark leather collar and simple chest strap only, one small dark metal tag with hand-painted crimson Noxian crest matching image3 shape. No plated body armor on this base form, no horns growing into weapons, no swords, no fire, no Darkin blades, no cybernetics.
Full body standing facing RIGHT in near-side battlefield three-quarter profile, eye level slightly above creature's back, all four feet and full tail visible and separated, alert calm stance, mouth slightly parted to show restrained teeth; compact enough for one battlefield hex. Natural anatomy, supported feet, no floating. Broad generous empty margins, creature centered.
Render like original 1999 Heroes III prerendered creature art translated through rich textured painting: matte hide, restrained warm upper-left light, clear shadow masses, softened finely painted edges, readable silhouette, limited warm steel glints. Match image4's grounded painted material treatment without copying its pixels. Avoid thick black outlines, flat vector blocks, shiny contemporary 3D, poster lighting, cute cartoon, fur wolf, reptile sprawl, flat crocodile muzzle, oversized dinosaur claws, any text or extra poses. One isolated full-body creature, transparent background.
